description: Latest EIA weekly average residential price per gallon (taxes included) of heating oil and propane for the US, an EIA region or a surveyed state, read at call time from eia.gov: price, change from last week, the last five survey weeks, the price a year ago and the next release date. Heating oil is surveyed in Northeast and Midwest states; propane in about 40 states. Uncovered states return the covered list.

state.description: State name or code ("Maine", "CT"), an EIA region ("New England (PADD 1A)") or "US". Default US.

name: get_heating_oil_propane_prices
title: Get heating oil and propane prices
